findings.title: Direct provider API calls bypassing Model Router in emergency_alert_engine

evidence.observation: Direct invocations of call_gemini and call_mistral using environment variables instead of routing through the model router service

proposed_action.description: Refactor emergency_alert_engine.py to use the centralized Model Router endpoint on port 8891 rather than calling GEMINI_API_KEY and MISTRAL_API_KEY directly.

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures centralized observability, rate limiting, and fallbacks managed by the Model Router.
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: router_bypass; Evidence strength: conclusive; Confidence: 0.90; Risk: medium; Automation: needs_signoff; Category reason: Router bypasses must be corrected by design review

findings.title: Model Router call log missing on filesystem

evidence.observation: router_status reports log file at /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl but call_log_exists is false and call_log_size_mb is null

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router process initializes and persists the call_log.jsonl file with appropriate directory write permissions.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility and historical telemetry logging for model inference calls.
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: observability_gap; Evidence strength: conclusive; Confidence: 0.90; Risk: low; Automation: needs_signoff; Category reason: Changes to running services require verification
